config.label: CIE AS & A Level Physics
config.author: Smartious Homeschool
config.description: The complete Smartious course notes for Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics (9702) in a single volume. 82 lessons covering AS physical quantities, kinematics, dynamics, forces, energy, deformation of solids, waves, electricity and atomic physics, A Level circular motion, gravitation, thermal physics, oscillations, electric fields, capacitors, magnetism, electromagnetic induction, alternating currents, quantum and nuclear physics, medical physics and astronomy and cosmology, with exam technique and practice papers for every paper. Organised lesson by lesson to follow the syllabus.
